question:
Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings.

Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/ words.

options.text: Rosemary was from the middle of the middle class, catapulted by her mother onto the uncharted heights of Hollywood.
They had been two days in Paris but actually they were still under the beach umbrella.
He walked on choking and would have marched directly up into the other party, but Abe stopped him.
This reproach of my dependance had become a vague sing-song in my ear.
